title: Information-Theoretic Secure Aggregation With Heterogeneous Client Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35833v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In federated learning (FL), secure aggregation enables a server to compute the sum of local model updates of $N$ clients, without revealing any information on the individual model updates to the server, beyond their sum. Different clients may be subject to heterogeneous bandwidth constraints, and consequently may choose different numbers of quantization levels to represent the information they send. Most secure aggregation works require the clients to project the values of their update parameters to a common finite group (or field), which does not directly accommodate heterogeneous precision constraints on their transmitted masked updates. Existing approaches of secure aggregation with heterogeneous quantization levels reveal partial aggregates of model-updates, and can reveal segments of individual model updates, under certain dropout and client-server collusion patterns. translated_title: 具有异构客户端量化的信息论安全聚合
translated_abstract: 在联邦学习（FL）中，安全聚合使服务器能够计算N个客户端的本地模型更新之和，而不向服务器泄露除总和之外的任何关于单个模型更新的信息。不同的客户端可能受到异构的带宽约束，因此可能选择不同数量的量化级别来表示它们所发送的信息。大多数安全聚合工作要求客户端将其更新参数的值投影到一个共同的有限群（或域）上，这无法直接适应其传输的掩码更新上存在的异构精度约束。现有的支持异构量化级别的安全聚合方法会泄露模型更新的部分聚合结果，并且在某些客户端掉线和客户端-服务器合谋的模式下，还可能泄露单个模型更新的片段。为防止这种隐私泄露，我们提出了一种信息论（安全的聚合方法）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对联邦学习中客户端量化精度异构的问题，提出了一种信息论安全的聚合方案，可防止在客户端掉线或合谋等情况下泄露部分聚合结果或单个模型更新的片段。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an information-theoretically secure aggregation scheme for federated learning that supports clients with heterogeneous quantization levels, preventing leakage of partial aggregates or segments of individual model updates under dropout and collusion patterns.
